Action: Log in as admin, open Settings -> API Keys, create key 'qa-key' for admin. (API POST /api/v1/api-keys)
Expected success symptom: Key shown ONCE with prefix nex_...; badge 'Sandbox Only' (allowLive false); roles inherited [admin, management].
Entry shows prefix, enabled true, allowLive false and no full secret.
Returns [] : the key is forced into admin's personal sandbox, live data is not visible.

Action: POST a customer 'S08 Sandbox Cust' with the key.
Expected success symptom: Created in the sandbox; Live customer list (x-user: admin) does NOT contain it.

Action: Toggle 'Allow Live Data Access' on the key (PUT /api/v1/api-keys/:id {allowLive:true}).
Expected success symptom: Badge becomes 'Live Allowed'; subsequent calls with the key see Live data ('S08 Live Cust').
Message 'API key revoked.'; using the key again returns HTTP 401.

Action: Log in choosing 'My Own Sandbox (Test Admin)'.
Expected success symptom: Persistent sandbox banner shows with Reset Data, Revert to Login State, Exit Sandbox; data of Live is not visible.

Action: In the sandbox press Reset Data and type RESET.
Expected success symptom: Sandbox business data cleared; users and groups preserved.

Action: Try POST /api/v1/wipe while in sandbox mode.
Expected success symptom: Rejected: 'Direct wipe is disabled in sandbox mode. Use /api/v1/sandbox/reset.'
Returned to login screen, localStorage cleared.
List contains the admin sandbox with size and member count.

Action: Open Settings -> modules and disable the Shipment module; log in as ship1.
Expected success symptom: Shipment menu disappears for ship1 (module off); re-enable restores it.

Action: Download the REST API user guide (Help Center or GET /api/v1/user-guide?format=markdown).
Expected success symptom: Markdown document 'NexusERP RESTful API User Guide' downloads.

Action: Create a full backup in Settings -> backups (GET /api/v1/full-backup with needed params).

Expected success symptom: Settings JSON returned with enableNewOrderAlerts false in the seeded instance.
